highlight.title: BGP Routing Failures: When the Internet Breaks
highlight.summary: Recent BGP outages at Cloudflare showed how routing mistakes can make websites disappear globally. When BGP withdraws routes, traffic can't find its destination—like removing road signs that tell cars where to go.

resources.title: Computer Network Facts for Kids - Kiddle Encyclopedia
resources.why_now: Perfect starting point that explains networks like connecting houses with roads, covering LANs, WANs, and how devices communicate using simple analogies.

resources.title: What Happens When You Type a URL in the Browser? - DEV Community
resources.why_now: Technical deep-dive into DNS resolution, TCP handshakes, and TLS encryption that shows the complex choreography behind every web request.

resources.title: Wi-Fi 2026 Predictions: AI-Powered Networks and Wi-Fi 8 Progress
resources.why_now: IEEE 802.11bn (Wi-Fi 8) draft is complete, and AI is transforming network management from cloud-based analytics to real-time device decisions.

resources.title: BGP Vortex: New Internet Routing Vulnerability Discovered
resources.why_now: Researchers found BGP Vortex can flood the internet with routing messages, potentially impacting 96% of networks—showing BGP's ongoing security challenges.

claude_take: Computer networking feels invisible until it breaks—then suddenly everyone notices. Recent BGP incidents remind us that the internet is held together by aging protocols designed 30+ years ago, yet we're building AI-powered network management on top of these foundations.
